title: Lightweight Patch Gate Summary Path
goal: Add a lightweight runtime path for patch-gate and patch-chain summaries that reports only verdict, status, reason, and minimal blockers without serializing full governance evidence.

problem_statement.current_state: The governance runtime already supports patch-chain and patch-gate evaluation, but the full result payload can be too heavy for direct operator consumption when only the outcome is needed.
problem_statement.gap: There is no bounded summary mode for patch-chain or patch-gate commands that can return a report-grade verdict without emitting the full evidence tree.
problem_statement.risk: Large governance payloads can stall or fail during serialization even when the decision itself is already known.

basis.scope: Add bounded summary output for patch-chain and patch-gate without changing decision logic, patch semantics, or promotion rules.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the --summary CLI flag, bounded patch-chain and patch-gate summary builders, and serialization fallback from the full result to the lightweight summary.
Document the new summary mode for patch-chain and patch-gate and describe the bounded report-grade payload.
Synchronize the textbook runtime instructions with the new summary option.

runtime_changes.serialization_fallback: summary payload returned if full JSON serialization fails

acceptance_criteria: python scripts/query_governance.py patch-chain --patch-id <PATCH_ID> --summary returns a bounded summary payload.
python scripts/query_governance.py patch-gate --patch-id <PATCH_ID> --target <path-or-surface> --summary returns a bounded summary payload.
Default patch-chain and patch-gate behavior remains unchanged.
Summary mode does not alter chain or gate decisions.

warnings: Summary mode is additive and does not alter gate or chain logic.
Full report generation remains available when --summary is omitted.
